prompt: Four of the five flags in src/flags.js have been on for over a year and nobody is willing to delete one, because nobody can say what turning it off would do. We also have no record of which changes shipped behind a flag and which deliberately did not. Fix both, without changing what the application does today.

assertions.description: src/flags.js still exports its isEnabled API
No flag was deleted, which would be a behaviour change
Each flag records the condition under which it goes away
Each flag records an owning team
No removal condition is TBD, none, or unknown
The template prompts for flagged yes or no, not only when a flag was used
The template asks why, not only whether
The application itself is left alone
